capabilities.name: Buy a car, home or travel policy
capabilities.question: Can you buy a car, home or travel insurance policy from start to finish in a chat with an AI agent?

US.note: Lemonade's AI bot Maya quotes and sells renters and home policies in a chat in its app. The Insurify, Experian and Liberty Mutual apps in ChatGPT give car insurance quotes, but you finish buying on their sites or the insurer's.

evidence.title: The Ultimate Lemonade Renters & Homeowners FAQ
Insurify expands ChatGPT plugin with real-time personalized quotes and in-chat shopping
Experian launches insurance marketplace app on ChatGPT
Liberty Mutual launches carrier-backed conversational AI quoting app in ChatGPT for auto insurance

GB.note: Lemonade's AI bot Maya asks you a few questions in a chat and sells contents and home cover in its UK app. The MoneySuperMarket and Go.Compare apps in ChatGPT give car and home quotes, but you buy on their sites.

evidence.title: What is an insurance quote?
Home insurance starting at £4
New MoneySuperMarket ChatGPT app
Go.Compare launches ChatGPT app to help consumers find a great deal on their insurance

DE.note: Lemonade sells contents and personal liability cover in its German app and website, but no German page we found says its AI bot Maya runs the sign-up there.

evidence.title: Hausrat & Privathaftpflichtversicherung FAQ
Lemonade: Hausrat und Privathaftpflicht schnell per App abschließen
Insurtech Lemonade: KI und Anti-Fraud-Checks

IN.note: PolicyX's Pixie chatbot (December 2025) gives live quotes and compares plans from more than 50 insurers, but it hands complex cases to an advisor and does not complete the purchase in the chat.

evidence.title: PolicyX launches Pixie, India's first AI insurance chatbot
PiXie, your AI insurance assistant

BR.note: HUBSEGS sells insurance entirely on WhatsApp with generative AI, from quote to a digital policy in the chat, in under three minutes, for brokers and their clients.

evidence.title: HUBSEGS comercializa seguros 100% pelo WhatsApp
HUBSEGS vende seguros pelo WhatsApp com GenAI

MX.note: We found no insurer, comparison site or AI assistant app that sells a policy in a chat in Mexico; most policies are still sold through human intermediaries.

evidence.title: Aseguradoras necesitan atender WhatsApp

CL.note: Líder Bci sells insurance on WhatsApp with conversational AI, from quote to payment and policy issue in two to three minutes, starting with the SOAP mandatory car insurance (May 2025).

evidence.title: Líder Bci habilita contratación de seguros por WhatsApp

CO.note: We found no AI that sells a policy in a chat in Colombia. The digital agency Seguro Canguro uses AI only to check car policy documents before it sends the policy.

evidence.title: La inteligencia artificial reduce a minutos la revisión de pólizas en Colombia: así funciona

ES.note: The Allianz Direct España app in ChatGPT (June 2026) quotes car insurance from a chat, but you finish buying on allianzdirect.es. Lemonade does not sell in Spain.

evidence.title: Allianz Direct España en ChatGPT: precios de seguros de coche al instante

FR.note: Lemonade sells home insurance for tenants and owners in France through its app and website, but no French page we found says its AI bot Maya runs the sign-up there, and no French insurer or comparison site app in ChatGPT was found.

evidence.title: L'assurance habitation préférée des propriétaires
Lemonade Insurance FAQs (France)

CA.note: Manulife's app in ChatGPT (September 2026, English and French) quotes CoverMe travel insurance, and MyChoice's ChatGPT app (April 2026) compares auto and life insurance across Canada, but you finish buying on their sites. Lemonade does not sell in Canada.

evidence.title: Manulife first in Canada to sell insurance via ChatGPT
MyChoice launches Canada's first auto and life insurance app on ChatGPT

JP.note: We found no insurer or comparison site in Japan that sells a car, home or travel policy start to finish in an AI chat; Lemonade does not operate in Japan, and the ChatGPT insurance apps we found serve the US and UK.

AU.note: BizCover's ChatGPT app (March 2026) gives small-business quotes from insurers such as QBE, Chubb and Zurich, but you buy on BizCover's site. Lemonade does not sell in Australia, and no insurer sells car, home or travel cover start to finish in a chat.

evidence.title: BizCover brings Australia's first AI-based insurance quotes to ChatGPT

NG.note: Heirs Insurance Group's generative AI assistant Prince AI (May 2026), on WhatsApp, its app and its website, lets customers buy and renew policies in English, Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa and other languages. No source says which products or whether payment finishes inside the chat, so the cell stays limited.

evidence.title: Heirs Insurance Group Launches Multi-Language AI Assistant to Deepen Insurance Access in Nigeria
Heirs Insurance sets the pace with Prince AI, Nigeria's first multi-language GenAI assistant

KR.note: I found no Korean insurer or app where an AI agent sells you a car, home or travel policy from start to finish in a chat. Toss's car-insurance comparison gives quotes in its app, but it is not an AI agent that completes the purchase.

SG.note: Pand.ai's GINA.sg bot on WhatsApp compares car insurance quotes and guides you to buy, with a cash-back offer. A 2021 release does not confirm that the policy is completed in the chat, and we found no 2026 source. We found no AI chat that sells home or travel cover in Singapore.

evidence.title: Local fintech Pand.ai launches Singapore's first bilingual digital insurance broker with Allianz, Etiqa and MSIG

ID.note: We found no Indonesian insurer or insurtech that sells a car, home or travel policy end to end in a chat with an AI agent. Qoala, the main local insurtech we checked, had only older sources (2020 to 2023) that we could open, so its current sales channels are unconfirmed.

IT.note: Laura.it has announced an AI car-insurance intermediary that was due to start in mid-October 2026, but no launch or in-chat purchase has been confirmed. A November 2025 survey found that six in ten Italian consumers used insurance chatbots and voicebots, mostly before buying a policy.

evidence.title: Laura.it vara l'assicurazione AI
IIA: 6 consumatori su 10 usano l'AI per interagire con l'Assicurazione

NL.note: Lemonade's AI bot Maya asks a few questions in the Dutch app and then shows a quote you can edit. You still install the app and finish the sign-up there, so the chat helps but you do the last step.

evidence.title: Dutch Review article on Lemonade's Maya quote flow

capabilities.name: File an insurance claim
capabilities.question: Can an insurer's AI agent take your claim in a chat, file it and move it forward, not only answer questions?

US.note: Lemonade's AI Jim takes renters, home, car and pet claims in a chat in its app, pays some instantly and passes the rest to a person.

evidence.title: How Lemonade's tech-powered claims work
The Ultimate Lemonade Renters & Homeowners FAQ
How to file a car insurance claim
How to file a pet insurance claim

GB.note: In Lemonade's UK app you tell AI Jim about your claim in a chat; it approves and pays simple claims at once and passes the rest to a person.

evidence.title: Making an insurance claim
New UK record? Lemonade pays claim in two seconds

DE.note: In Lemonade's German app, "Schaden melden" opens a chat with AI Jim, which takes the claim through every step.

evidence.title: So meldest du einen Schaden bei Lemonade

IN.note: HDFC ERGO's WhatsApp chatbot registers motor claims, runs an AI photo inspection and settles minor damage claims up to Rs 20,000 straight to your bank account.

evidence.title: Know how to get your instant motor claim settlement via WhatsApp

BR.note: Porto's conversational AI agent on WhatsApp lets policyholders across Brazil open and finish a car theft claim, and it handles 70% of those claims (October 2026). Mapfre's AI agent on WhatsApp and EZZE's AI chat assistant also open car claims.

evidence.title: Porto automatiza 70% dos sinistros de roubo e furto
EZZE Seguros amplia IA e corta etapas e ligações nos sinistros Auto
MAPFRE implementa primeira jornada de sinistro 100% resolutiva por IA no WhatsApp

MX.note: Quálitas's Quali-bot on WhatsApp answers claim questions, collects documents and sends you to Ajuste Express to send photos, but we found no AI that files or moves the claim. The only source is written by Blip, the bot's maker.

evidence.title: Aseguradoras necesitan atender WhatsApp

CL.note: We found no Chilean insurer whose AI takes and moves a claim in a chat; Líder Bci's WhatsApp AI sells policies, but we found nothing on claims.

CO.note: BNP Paribas Cardif Colombia handles claims on WhatsApp: its AI reads and checks the documents you send and decides whether the claim stays automated or goes to an advisor (May 2023).

evidence.title: Aseguradora utiliza la IA para la evaluación y pagos de pólizas

ES.note: Mapfre's AI super-assistant on phone and WhatsApp in Spain spots claim calls, collects the details and routes them to the right team, but no source says it files or moves the claim forward; Mapfre's WhatsApp AI agent that opens car claims is documented only in Brazil.

evidence.title: Mapfre activa un superasistente de IA en teléfono, WhatsApp y canales digitales
Mapfre desarrolla más de 150 casos de uso de IA durante 2025

FR.note: In Lemonade's French app, "Déclarer un sinistre" opens a chat with AI Jim, which asks a few questions, approves and pays simple claims at once and passes the rest to a person.

evidence.title: Comment déclarer un sinistre avec Lemonade ?

CA.note: TD Insurance's generative AI virtual assistant (May 2026, English and French) answers from TD Insurance web pages without logging in; TD says reporting claims in natural language is a possible future use. No Canadian insurer agent that files a claim in chat was found.

evidence.title: Let's Chat Coverage: TD Insurance Rolls Out New Virtual Assistant
TD Insurance releases client-facing chatbot

JP.note: Rakuten General Insurance has run an AI voice system since December 2024 that takes fire and personal accident claims by phone and passes the call to a person when it cannot finish. Sompo Japan's call center AI fills in claim details from a call. We found no insurer whose AI takes a claim in a chat and settles it.

evidence.title: 火災保険と傷害保険の事故受付に「AI自動音声システム」導入(楽天損保)

AU.note: No Australian insurer was found whose AI agent takes a claim in a chat and moves it forward; IAG's OpenAI voice agents are due in the first half of FY27, and Lemonade is not in Australia.

NG.note: Heirs Insurance Group's generative AI assistant Prince AI (May 2026) lets customers start a claim and track it on WhatsApp, the SimpleLife app and the website. Sources do not say whether it checks documents or settles claims itself.

evidence.title: Heirs Insurance Group Launches Multi-Language AI Assistant to Deepen Insurance Access in Nigeria
Heirs Insurance sets the pace with Prince AI, Nigeria's first multi-language GenAI assistant

KR.note: I found no Korean insurer whose AI agent takes a claim in a chat and moves it forward. My one search on Korean insurers' AI claim tools found only general industry reports.

SG.note: We found no Singapore insurer AI that files a claim and moves it forward. FWD Singapore's Faith chatbot explains how to submit a travel claim, and the article does not say it files one. We could not find a date for that article.

ID.note: We found no Indonesian insurer whose AI agent takes a claim in a chat and moves it forward. Older reports of a WhatsApp claim bot at Qoala could not be confirmed from a dated source.

IT.note: No insurer in Italy was found where an AI agent takes a claim in chat and moves it forward. A November 2025 survey found that over half of Italian consumers would be ready to use advanced AI assistants to buy a policy or report a claim, but that is stated interest, not a product.

evidence.title: IIA: 6 consumatori su 10 usano l'AI per interagire con l'Assicurazione

NL.note: In Lemonade's Dutch app, you file a claim by starting a chat with the claims bot AI Jim from your policy page.

evidence.title: Zo dien je een Lemonade claim in
